premise: Ladybug counts her spots, Bee's stripes and Flower's petals, then her friends, and takes her proudest bow at the end.
inspiration: The folk counting rhyme, turned so the biggest count is not of things but of friends, and the friends count her back.
lesson: Friends are the best thing to count.

en-US.title: Ladybug Counts Her Friends
en-US.text: Ladybug {ladybug:pulse} loved counting. [excited] First, my spots! One, two, three, four, five. {ladybug:hop} Five spots! Bee {bee:float loop 0.4} {sfx:buzz} buzzed down. Count my stripes! One, two. {bee:sparkle} Two stripes! Next, the flower's petals. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. {flower:wobble} [giggles] Eight petals, and one tickly bee. Then Ladybug tried the biggest count of all. [curious] How many friends do I have? She counted Bee. One. She counted Flower. Two. Butterfly {butterfly:float loop 0.3} fluttered by. Three! [happily] Three friends! {ladybug:live} Ladybug lifted her red wing cases, fluttered her wings, folded them neatly away… and took a very proud bow. [softly] And her friends counted too: one little ladybug. The very best one. {ladybug:hearts}

es-ES.title: Mariquita cuenta a sus amigos
es-ES.text: A Mariquita {ladybug:pulse} le encantaba contar. [excited] ¡Primero, mis lunares! Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco. {ladybug:hop} ¡Cinco lunares! Abeja {bee:float loop 0.4} {sfx:buzz} bajó zumbando. ¡Cuenta mis rayas! Una, dos. {bee:sparkle} ¡Dos rayas! Después, los pétalos de la flor. Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete, ocho. {flower:wobble} [giggles] Ocho pétalos, y una abeja que hace cosquillas. Entonces Mariquita probó la cuenta más grande de todas. [curious] ¿Cuántos amigos tengo? Contó a Abeja. Una. Contó a Flor. Dos. Mariposa {butterfly:float loop 0.3} pasó revoloteando. ¡Tres! [happily] ¡Tres amigas! {ladybug:live} Mariquita levantó sus alas rojas, agitó las alitas de debajo, las guardó bien dobladas… e hizo una reverencia muy orgullosa. [softly] Y sus amigas también contaron: una mariquita pequeñita. La mejor de todas. {ladybug:hearts}
